nodes.name: Observe → classify → dry-run → confirm → execute → readback
nodes.description: Default LLM mutation loop. Gather current state first, classify the exact operation including nested executors, run a non-mutating dry-run when available, obtain confirmation for T2, execute one bounded action, then verify with readback and evidence.
nodes.use_when: Any task that may alter KoL, KoLmafia state, scripts, inventory, turns, equipment, choices, or preferences.
nodes.avoid_when: Never skip directly from intent to a raw executor just because the command is familiar.
nodes.verify_with: v2 state reads + audit id + active session evidence

nodes.name: Installed runtime beats remembered docs
nodes.description: Prefer the installed KoLmafia runtime for exact command/function availability: version, help/which, ashref/jsref, prefref/modref. External docs are orientation and historical context.
nodes.use_when: Syntax, function names, overloads, preferences, or command behavior may have changed.

nodes.name: Browser is evidence, not authority
nodes.description: Use the relay mini-browser for page text/HTML/screenshots. Do not treat DOM click/fill/navigation as an execution authority for AI automation.
nodes.use_when: Visual state or relay page structure matters.

nodes.name: Session files are evidence, not execution authority
nodes.description: Tail the active session or dated session log to correlate gCLI output and game events with a requested action. Reading the log does not authorize or perform the action.
nodes.use_when: Correlating command output, drift, or live KoLmafia activity.

nodes.name: Expand nested executors before classification
nodes.description: Aliases, ash/js snippets, call/run/exec, cli_execute, visit_url, moods/triggers, control-flow commands, and command-bearing outfit names can hide the real effect. Classify the resolved inner operation, not only the outer verb.
nodes.use_when: Any command accepts code, another command, URL, script, function, alias, or deferred action.

nodes.name: External intelligence ≠ live account state
nodes.description: Loathers services provide community datasets and calculators. They can inform reasoning, but do not override local current character/session state and should not be mistaken for KoLmafia execution surfaces.

nodes.name: Headless runner is a privileged execution lane
nodes.description: The isolated headless runner launches KoLmafia --CLI and sends script/CLI commands through a PTY. It is useful for bounded jobs but sits outside the guarded MCP path unless separately wrapped.
nodes.use_when: Explicitly authorized isolated jobs or validation of headless behavior.
nodes.avoid_when: Do not silently use as a bypass when the guarded bridge denies an action.

nodes.name: pymafia embedded JVM is a privileged developer lane
nodes.description: pymafia can call KoLmafia RuntimeLibrary functions through AshRuntime inside an embedded JVM. This is powerful for development/introspection and must inherit the same classifier/gating rules if exposed to an LLM.
nodes.avoid_when: Do not treat direct RuntimeLibrary access as implicitly safe.

usecases: Start from local runtime truth. Use help/which to enumerate the installed command surface; use version to pin the build before consulting older docs.
Use runtime introspection before guessing ASH/JS function names or script namespaces.
Inline evaluation is powerful because the nested statement may itself mutate state. Gate the statement, not only the outer verb.
Script dispatch commands are nested executors. Authorization should bind to the actual script/function and arguments.
Use unique markers plus the active session file to correlate requested commands with emitted gCLI/session output.
Prefer read-only inspection before refresh or mutation.
Use get/prefref for current value/discovery; ptrace can observe changes during controlled tests.
Local configuration changes can persist and influence later commands, so log them as state transitions.
Simulation commands are safer than maximize/equip for answering “what would happen?” questions.
Adventure and choice commands consume turns or change quest state; `?` preview syntax does not apply uniformly to every command.
Inventory verbs can cascade into crafting, buying, or consumption. Treat high-level convenience verbs as broader than their name suggests.
Separate read-only market lookup from purchasing/listing/repricing actions.
These affect other players or shared clan state and should be a separate authorization boundary.
Install/update/delete commands alter executable code or runtime data and should not inherit ordinary gameplay authorization.
Prefer abort and diagnostics before lifecycle commands such as logout/exit.
